summary.intent: Complete trail 164 (semantic type checker correctness fixes) via a delegated agent, publish the resulting branches as PRs, and kick off follow-on trails 165-167 in parallel.
summary.outcome: Trail 164 produced three signed branches (stale-cache invalidation, merge parity, config-ignored warning) that were pushed as PRs #300-#302 with correct stacked bases and bodies; trail 167 workers were launched, and trail 166 was deferred.

repo: Repo is caliper (Rust workspace: crates/core, crates/cli) with changesets in .changeset/ and docs in docs/; each fix ships a changeset and docs update.
SemanticHook caches checker answers keyed by the component's own file, so edits to imported files (e.g. props interface) left stale types in 'on-demand' mode until the cache was invalidated.

Whole-project merge and session merge in semantic types differ on purpose: batch merge lets the checker decide which props exist (drops unreturned props like `legacy`), while session merge keeps them and takes @types/react className under htmlAttributes: full.
OpaqueType, MaxDepthExceeded and CircularReference diagnostics name the component rather than the prop, so they can only be cleared once no opaque props remain.

`check`, `inspect` and `watch` never run the TypeScript checker; only `extract` does, so experimentalSemanticTypes/tscPath config was silently ignored. The warning goes to stderr so --strict exit codes are unchanged.
Architecture test has an allowlist; trail 167 aims to move option enums to types/ with re-exports to keep public paths and the semver check intact.
Quality gates run per branch: full test suite, clippy, lint, doc-check, typos, machete; commits are signed.

code.finding: Added SemanticHook::invalidate with a generation counter so in-flight answers are not stored after an edit; called from update_file, ensure_fresh, config-change rebuild and cold paths. Existing `let _ = session.initialize()` pattern trips clippy::let_underscore_must_use under --all-targets (trail 165).
keep_unanswered bool replaced by private Unanswered::{Drop, Keep} enum controlling whether opaque diagnostics are retained during on-demand merge.

workflow: Delegating each trail to a background agent in an isolated git worktree, with the agent forbidden to push or merge, lets the orchestrator verify signatures and then push/open PRs itself.
Proving tests fail before a fix and pass after (including temporarily disabling a feature to confirm e2e tests catch it) gives credible evidence for PR bodies.
Stacked PRs need explicit base branches; the dependent branch must merge after its base.
Performance trails (166) are deferred until the machine is quiet so measurements are reliable.

friction: Branch 1 fell 10 commits behind origin/main by the time the agent finished, since an earlier draft status had noted it.
Existing test lint pattern (`let _ =` on must_use) conflicts with clippy --all-targets, forcing the agent to leave it alone and use drop(...) in new tests.
Trail 166 cannot run concurrently with others because benchmark numbers need a quiet machine.
open_items: Merge branch 1 (PR #300) into main before branch 2 (PR #301), and consider merging origin/main into branch 1.
Narrow SemanticHook invalidation using the resolver's per-component Dependencies if measurement shows full invalidation is too costly.
Retained opaque diagnostic is conservative and may remain for a prop the checker answered; could be refined.
Fix `let _ = session.initialize()` clippy lint in semantic_hook tests under trail 165.
Start trail 166 (watch performance) after trail 165 finishes and the machine is quiet.
Decide whether feat/cross-file-render-evidence (trail 156) warrants an ADR.
Trail 167 workers must still produce branches for ARCH-4 option enum move and the architecture/ADR docs refresh.
